Also, the first two minutes after graduation show a launch bot and heavy early flow, with bundle share at 21.7%, a pattern that fits post-graduation exit liquidity more than an operator-backed run.

Pool depth (76.8 SOL) and volume (~$36k in 15 min) are adequate for a $5-10 ticket, and a 1.4-5% round trip is survivable, but size is not the issue. The base rate for buying a coin in this state is poor, and the trend says the dip is still in progress.

If the desk overrode the refusal anyway: $5 ticket, 20% stop, 15-minute hold, exit on any further drawdown. I would not recommend it.
